notes: LT-03.3a finite queue/readiness/selection oracle. Every payload is a literal, schema-bound value; compact {index} group ranges only enumerate already-declared members and never implement queue/readiness/selection logic. matching_count/eligible_count, status_counts, counters, membership, readiness transitions and snapshot contents are declared literals and cross-checked by contractlib.queue_selections; no matcher, readiness detector, count or selection algorithm is implemented.

rule_set.note: Accepted LT-03.2b published RuleSet identity; LT-03.3b must reuse the same rule_set_id/members for preview.

readiness.note: Finite observation sequences. The expected state is a declared literal; the checker only confirms the declared sequence satisfies the Q-022 criteria (two equal size/mtime observations at least 5s apart without an unfinished marker; change/rename returns to WAITING_READY with a new content revision; a claim does not change the content revision).

items.reason: Two stable observations with equal size/mtime at least 5 seconds apart and no unfinished marker produce READY.
A changed size/mtime invalidates the previous readiness and returns the item to WAITING_READY with a new content revision.
A rename invalidates the previous readiness and returns the item to WAITING_READY with a new content revision.
An unfinished incoming marker keeps the item in WAITING_READY even when the two observations look equal.
A claim moves the item to PROCESSING but does not change the content revision of the source.

queries.reason: READY filter: matching and eligible both 120; the page is capped at 100 and continues with a cursor.

Empty statuses selects all active states; MISSING is excluded from the default active queue, so matching_count is 130 and eligible_count counts only selectable READY plus the stable REQUIRES_DECISION item (121).
MISSING appears only under an explicit status filter; it is never eligible for a batch.
query_text is a declared case-insensitive substring filter; the matching item set is a literal list, not a computed matcher.
Zero READY files: the filter matches nothing, so an ALL_MATCHING selection is rejected with EMPTY_SELECTION.
Company still has DISCOVERED/WAITING_READY items, but none is selectable.
1001 eligible files exceed max_batch_items=1000; the page is still capped at 100 and the batch request is rejected without truncation.

A REQUIRES_DECISION item without a claim is selectable only when its source is confirmed stable; the unstable no-claim item stays selectable=false and is not eligible. Stability is declared explicitly and is not a QueueItem field.

selection_scenarios.reason: A single explicit item is frozen with its content revision; selected_count is 1.
A multi-item EXPLICIT snapshot may include items that are not on the first queue page; membership is not limited to the current page.
ALL_MATCHING freezes all 120 eligible READY files, including the 20 that are off the first page; the expected count must match before creation.

selection_errors.message: Нет доступных файлов для выбранного фильтра.
selection_errors.reason: Zero eligible files produce 422 EMPTY_SELECTION; no snapshot is created and no file operation runs.

selection_errors.message: Выбрано больше файлов, чем допускает одна партия.
selection_errors.reason: 1001 eligible files exceed max_batch_items=1000; the whole set is rejected with 422 BATCH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and is never silently truncated.

selection_errors.message: Состав подходящих файлов изменился. Обновите выбор.
selection_errors.reason: The operator saw 119 but the current eligible set is 120; the mismatch returns 409 SELECTION_CHANGED before any snapshot is created.
A snapshot is bound to the creating user_id; another user gets 403 FORBIDDEN on the preview operation.

selection_errors.message: Снимок выбора истёк. Создайте его заново.
selection_errors.reason: An expired snapshot is rejected on the real preview operation with 409 SELECTION_EXPIRED; no new endpoint is introduced.

selection_errors.message: Снимок выбора истёк. Создайте его заново.
selection_errors.reason: An expired snapshot is rejected on the real batch operation with 409 SELECTION_EXPIRED; no new endpoint is introduced.
An unknown selection id returns 404 NOT_FOUND on the preview operation.

ownership.reason: A new session of the same user_id may use the snapshot; the binding is to the user, not to a session.
A different user is rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN before any calculation.
The same user cannot preview an expired snapshot.
The same user cannot start an expired snapshot as a batch.

sequences.reason: After a successful snapshot a new matching arrival does not change or invalidate it by itself and is not included.
Changing the current UI filter does not silently rebuild the frozen membership.
The snapshot TTL is the demo five minutes; expiry is a server-side decision.

invalid_requests.reason: company_id is required; a queue request without a company has no global queue.
company_id is required on both SelectionRequest variants.
EXPLICIT items has minItems 1; an empty explicit selection is a schema error, not EMPTY_SELECTION.
EXPLICIT items has maxItems 1000; a 1001-item explicit request is schema-rejected, while the 1001 eligible ALL_MATCHING case is the domain BATCH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
mode is constrained to EXPLICIT or ALL_MATCHING by the oneOf request schema.
additionalProperties is false; the client cannot pin a page of ids into an ALL_MATCHING request.
The JSON Schema cannot express item_id uniqueness; the domain rejects duplicate explicit items (documented, not executed).
The item id is schema-valid but unknown to the company; the domain rejects the reference (documented, not executed).
An explicit item from another company is schema-valid but rejected by the domain scope check (documented, not executed).

mutations.reason: status_counts READY must agree with counters.ready=120.
attention must be REQUIRES_DECISION + RECOVERY_REQUIRED only.
A selectable item must not carry an active claim.
A matching_count above the limit must page exactly limit items.
MISSING must not appear in the default active queue.
selected_count must equal the frozen membership size.
A selection snapshot cannot mix companies.
Explicit members must resolve to a queue item of the same company.
A frozen member revision must equal the current queue item revision.
READY requires two equal observations at least 5 seconds apart.
An unfinished marker must prevent READY.
The snapshot queue_generation must equal the generation of its source queue.
